headline: It is a calm day: United's hubs are running normally.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better.
630 United flights, including United Express, are in the air right now, about the usual number for this time of day; the past 7 days' median at this hour was 641.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report. The FAA's operations plan lists a possible ground stop for flights into Boston until 7:30 PM ET, which is not in effect.
